news.title: Wild crabapples have genetic potential to improve domestic varieties
news.summary_en: WashU plant scientist Ben Mansfeld is studying the genome of wild crabapples to find helpful traits to develop in domestic apple varieties.

news.title: WashU research finds gaps in Google AI Overview citations, claims
news.summary_en: With the advent of Google AI Overviews, Google has unprecedented editorial control over what users read and know, according to Jacob Montgomery, a WashU Arts & Sciences political scientist.

news.title: Frequent cannabis use tied to more severe epilepsy
news.summary_en: A study led by WashU Medicine researchers found that near-daily cannabis users with drug-resistant epilepsy had over twice as many convulsive seizures as nonusers, and they became resistant to antiseizure medications faster.
